data_requests.item: Existing named-system service, pressure/end-use and dynamic control/storage basis
where: site records: Existing actual compressor/system and controls, pressure location and discharge/header/point-of-use profiles, actual end-use requirements, distribution/treatment losses, peak/transient demand, storage/control range and manufacturer constraints; exact source/owner/revision, units/time/availability and coverage retained.

site records: The following pressure/control tag/series locations are candidate-only lookup aids from supplied records; compressor/system association, source identity, availability, measurement location and requirements remain unverified. Do not treat a foreign or unknown candidate as this compressor's measured header pressure or minimum end-use requirement.
historian or DCS trend for PIC-A (no historian tag is mapped in this model for these)

a walkdown: Only if existing records leave an applicable question unresolved, agree safe additional observations with the responsible engineer; no compulsory new measurement, production stop, setpoint change or retrofit.
data_requests.how: A pressure record anywhere is not this compressor's control or another user's requirement, and missing control representation is not closure. Known helpers/process-gas/refrigeration compressors are not air subjects; an air-compressor package is not disqualified merely because its name also mentions a dryer. Establish actual service/requirements and match quantities, locations and dynamic operating coverage. Review appropriate existing records and component/storage/control constraints before considering pressure changes. Suitable requirements or existing configuration can be acknowledged without new tests or lower-setpoint instructions.

questions.decision_rule: Review actual system/end-use requirements and matched pressure/location/time records, peak demand, distribution/component drops, storage/control and manufacturer constraints with the responsible specialist before a pressure decision. Highest scalar need plus an assumed loss alone does not authorize lowering a setpoint. Unknown scope or dynamic basis remains a records question, and suitable existing operation or nonapplicability may be acknowledged; no operating change or site savings are calculated.

typical_benefit.wording: S11 explains that pressure can affect compressor power and unregulated demand, with effects depending on compressor/control type, pressure range and operating conditions. Review manufacturer/system performance and required end-use pressure; no universal saving per pressure step or site benefit is asserted.

questions.limits: IAC/ITAC figures are browse-page averages read through a summarizing fetch and not re-verified against the downloadable database; averages are skewed by outliers. Source review: S11 printed28-36/PDF33-41, including full pressure/control context. Its printed31 increase and printed34 decrease passages give inconsistent combined percentage ranges; no corrected number is chosen. Original numeric wording remains historical, not a universal target or a reason to compromise minimum end-use pressure.
